articles.title_en: The Economics of the Public Option: Evidence from Local Pharmaceutical Markets
articles.title_cn: 公共选项的经济学：来自地方药品市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of competition by state-owned firms, leveraging the decentralized entry of public pharmacies to local markets in Chile. Public pharmacies sell the same drugs at a third of private pharmacy prices, because of stronger upstream bargaining and market power in the private sector, but are of lower quality. Public pharmacies induced market segmentation and price increases in the private sector, which benefited the switchers to the public option but harmed the stayers. The countrywide entry of public pharmacies would reduce yearly consumer drug expenditure by 1.6 percent. (JEL D22, I18, L32, L65, O14)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了国有企业竞争的影响，利用了智利公共药房向地方市场分散进入的特点。公共药房以私人药房价格的三分之一出售相同的药品，这是因为上游议价能力更强以及私人部门的市场势力，但公共药房的质量较低。公共药房导致了市场分割和私人部门的价格上涨，这有利于转向公共选项的消费者，但损害了留在私人部门的消费者。全国范围内的公共药房进入将每年减少消费者药品支出1.6%。（JEL D22, I18, L32, L65, O14）

articles.title_en: The Effect of Macroeconomic Uncertainty on Household Spending
articles.title_cn: 宏观经济不确定性对家庭支出的影响
articles.abstract_en: We use randomized treatments that provide different types of information about the first and/or second moments of future economic growth to generate exogenous changes in the perceived macroeconomic uncertainty of treated households. The effects on their spending decisions relative to an untreated control group are measured in follow-up surveys. Our results indicate that, after taking into account first moments, higher macroeconomic uncertainty induces households to significantly and persistently reduce their total monthly spending in subsequent months. Changes in spending are broad based across spending categories and apply to larger durable good purchases as well. (JEL D12, D81, D84, E21, E23, G51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用随机化处理，提供关于未来经济增长第一和/或第二时刻的不同类型信息，以生成受处理家庭感知宏观经济不确定性的外生变化。与未处理对照组相比，其支出决策的影响在后续调查中测量。我们的结果表明，在考虑第一时刻后，更高的宏观经济不确定性促使家庭在随后几个月显著且持续地减少其总月度支出。支出的变化在支出类别中广泛存在，并且也适用于较大的耐用品购买。（JEL D12, D81, D84, E21, E23, G51）

articles.abstract_en: Betas from return regressions are commonly used to measure systematic financial market risks. “Good” beta measurements are essential for a range of empirical inquiries in finance and macroeconomics. We introduce a novel econometric framework for the nonparametric estimation of time-varying betas with high-frequency data. The “local Gaussian” property of the generic continuous-time benchmark model enables optimal “finite-sample” inference in a well-defined sense. It also affords more reliable inference in empirically realistic settings compared to conventional large-sample approaches. Two applications pertaining to the tracking performance of leveraged ETFs and an intraday event study illustrate the practical usefulness of the new procedures. (JEL C22, C58, G12, G23)
articles.abstract_cn: 来自收益回归的贝塔值通常用于衡量系统性金融市场风险。“良好”的贝塔值测量对于金融和宏观经济学的众多实证研究至关重要。我们引入了一种新颖的计量经济学框架，用于高频数据下时变贝塔值的非参数估计。通用连续时间基准模型的“局部高斯”性质使得在明确定义的意义上能够进行最优的“有限样本”推断。与传统的大样本方法相比，它在实证现实环境中也提供了更可靠的推断。两个应用分别涉及杠杆ETF的跟踪表现和日内事件研究，说明了新程序的实际用途。（JEL C22, C58, G12, G23）

articles.title_cn: 匹配排序的比较静态分析
articles.abstract_en: We create a general and tractable theory of increasing sorting in pairwise matching models with monetary transfers. The positive quadrant dependence partial order subsumes Becker (1973) as the extreme cases with most and least sorting and implies increasing regression coefficients. Our theory turns on synergy—the cross-partial difference or derivative of match production. This reflects basic economic forces: diminishing returns, technological convexity, insurance, and learning dynamics. We prove sorting increases if match synergy globally increases, and is cross-sectionally monotone or single crossing. We use our results to derive sorting predictions in major economics sorting papers and in new applications. (JEL C78, D21, D82, D86, J12)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个关于带货币转移的配对匹配模型中递增排序的一般且易处理的理论。正象限依赖偏序将Becker（1973）作为排序最多和最少两个极端情况包含在内，并意味着递增的回归系数。我们的理论依赖于协同效应——匹配产出的交叉偏差异或导数。这反映了基本的经济力量：边际收益递减、技术凸性、保险和学习动态。我们证明，如果匹配协同效应全局增加，则排序增加，并且排序在横截面上是单调的或具有单交叉性质。我们利用我们的结果在主要经济学排序论文和新应用中推导出排序预测。（JEL C78, D21, D82, D86, J12）

articles.title_en: Hub-and-Spoke Cartels: Theory and Evidence from the Grocery Industry
articles.title_cn: 轮轴辐条式卡特尔：来自杂货业的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: Numerous recently uncovered cartels operated along the supply chain, with firms at one end facilitating collusion at the other—hub-and-spoke arrangements. These cartels are hard to rationalize because they induce double marginalization and higher costs. We examine Canada’s alleged bread cartel and provide the first comprehensive analysis of hub-and-spoke collusion. Using court documents and pricing data, we make three contributions: (i) we show that collusion was effective, increasing inflation by about 50 percent; (ii) we provide evidence that collusion existed at both ends of the supply chain; and (iii) we develop a model explaining why this form of collusion arose. (JEL E31, K21, L12, L14, L22, L42, L81)
articles.abstract_cn: 许多近期被揭露的卡特尔沿着供应链运作，一端的企业促进另一端的合谋——即轮轴辐条式安排。这些卡特尔难以合理化，因为它们导致双重边际化和更高的成本。我们考察了加拿大涉嫌的面包卡特尔，并提供了对轮轴辐条式合谋的首次全面分析。利用法院文件和定价数据，我们做出了三项贡献：（i）我们表明合谋是有效的，使通货膨胀率增加了约50%；（ii）我们提供了供应链两端均存在合谋的证据；（iii）我们开发了一个模型来解释为何会出现这种形式的合谋。（JEL E31, K21, L12, L14, L22, L42, L81）

articles.title_en: Does the Squeaky Wheel Get More Grease? The Direct and Indirect Effects of Citizen Participation on Environmental Governance in China
articles.title_cn: 吱吱作响的轮子是否得到更多润滑？公民参与对中国环境治理的直接和间接影响
articles.abstract_en: We conducted a nationwide field experiment in China to evaluate the direct and indirect impacts of assigning firms to public or private citizen appeals when they violate pollution standards. There are three main findings. First, public appeals to the regulator through social media substantially reduce violations and pollution emissions, while private appeals cause more modest environmental improvements. Second, public appeals appear to tilt regulators’ focus away from facilitating economic growth and toward avoiding pollution-induced public unrest. Third, pollution reductions by treated firms are not offset by control firms, based on randomly varying the proportion of treated firms at the prefecture level. (JEL D22, L82, P28, P31, Q52, Q53, Q58)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在中国进行了一项全国性的实地实验，以评估当企业违反污染标准时，指派企业接受公众或私人公民申诉的直接和间接影响。主要有三个发现。第一，通过社交媒体向监管机构提出的公开申诉显著减少了违规行为和污染排放，而私下申诉则带来较为温和的环境改善。第二，公开申诉似乎使监管机构的关注点从促进经济增长转向避免污染引发的公众不安。第三，根据在地级市层面随机变化处理企业比例，处理企业的污染减少并未被控制企业所抵消。(JEL D22, L82, P28, P31, Q52, Q53, Q58)

articles.title_en: The Gender Gap in Confidence: Expected but Not Accounted For
articles.title_cn: 自信中的性别差距：意料之中但未被考虑
articles.abstract_en: We investigate how the gender gap in confidence affects the views that evaluators (e.g., employers) hold about men and women. We find the confidence gap is contagious, causing evaluators to form overly pessimistic beliefs about women. This result arises even though the confidence gap is expected and even though the confidence gap shouldn’t be contagious if evaluators are Bayesian. Only an intervention that facilitates Bayesian updating proves (somewhat) effective. Additional results highlight how similar findings follow even when there is no room for discriminatory motives or differences in priors because evaluators are asked about arbitrary, rather than gender-specific, groups. (JEL D82, D83, D91, J16, J22, M51)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了自信中的性别差距如何影响评估者（如雇主）对男性和女性的看法。我们发现自信差距具有传染性，导致评估者对女性形成过度悲观的信念。即使自信差距是意料之中的，且如果评估者是贝叶斯式的，自信差距不应具有传染性，这一结果仍然出现。只有促进贝叶斯更新的干预措施被证明（在一定程度上）有效。其他结果强调，即使没有歧视动机或先验差异的空间，因为评估者被问及的是任意群体而非特定性别群体，类似发现也会出现。（JEL D82, D83, D91, J16, J22, M51）
